items.text: Brock Bowers is doubtful; Ladd McConkey practiced and is questionable (Raiders/Chargers Friday report).
items.why: Knee injury; meniscus procedure context earlier; unlikely to play vs Chargers.
items.implication: TE target vacuum in LV; Michael Mayer or others elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Bowers high prior usage; Mayer as handcuff/backup.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs. Raiders due to rib injury; practiced Friday.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited practice Friday after prior DNPs.
items.implication: Game-time feel; if out, boosts Quentin Johnston and others in LAC WR room.
items.opportunity: ETR notes Tre Harris as primary beneficiary if OUT.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs. Saints due to hamstring.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring in Week 1; limited Friday after DNPs; not expected to play.
items.implication: Significant loss of Lamar Jackson's top target; Bateman and others elevated.
items.opportunity: Ja'Kobi Lane already IR (wrist); hierarchy shifts to Bateman/Walker/Wester etc.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury; Burrow said he would play.
items.implication: Expected active; monitor for any limitation impacting Chase/Higgins.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected if plays; no major role change.

items.text: Still unclear how much TreVeyon Henderson can earn at expense of Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR; nice upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Henderson: 'I'm ready to go'; full practices; Brown IR creates need for playmakers.
items.implication: Potential timeshare expansion or flex value; monitor snap/role split vs Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Explosive role vs Stevenson; schedule favorability pre-bye.
items.conflict: Unclear exact earn vs Stevenson workload.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs look like: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. (Ja'Kobi Lane on IR/return).
items.why: Flowers second straight DNP Thursday; Lane fractured wrist IR.
items.implication: Bateman primary fantasy beneficiary for targets/routes if Flowers inactive.
items.opportunity: Clear depth chart elevation for remaining WRs behind Flowers/Lane.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring Wednesday practice (Houston Chronicle); missed 5 games on hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15, Wayne 8.
items.why: Hamstring + history; high route share confirms alpha role.
items.implication: Confirms massive opportunity loss; Hutchinson/Boutte primary next-up.
items.opportunity: 37/42 routes underscores target monopoly when healthy.

items.text: Early Week 2 injury waiver beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Kyler Murray=Carson Wentz. Streamers include Wentz, Kendre Miller, Bateman, Deebo etc.
items.why: Precise injury-linked adds based on roles/absence.
items.implication: Prioritize these for immediate opportunity from absences.
items.opportunity: Direct depth chart/role expansion for listed beneficiaries.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted on 40% routes (tied team lead). Indy just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + soft matchup vs weak IND run D.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; massive season potential if healthy.
items.opportunity: 74% snaps, high target share, goal-line implied.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan for league lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization under Kubiak; prior injury overreaction.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% target share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, both RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Clear lead back usage vs soft CLE front.
items.opportunity: 26% tgt share, red-zone monopoly, route edge.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; averages 93 rec yds/18.0 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears D soft vs WRs.
items.why: Elite share + proven Wentz chemistry + matchup.
items.implication: WR1 lock even with Murray out/Wentz starting.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1; 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script bad for rushes.
items.implication: Fade/sit; Miller more interesting if Kamara limited.
items.opportunity: Split rushes; pass-game dependent; Kamara threat.
